name: markdown-preview-colours
description: Colour presets for the built-in Markdown preview: headings, bold text, inline code, quotes and links. Preview only; Markdown files are never changed.

enumDescriptions: Green-teal headings, amber bold, orange inline code.
Plum and lavender headings with blue, yellow, red and green accents.
Red headings on near-black, white bold, cyan links.
Gold, amber and orange headings on near-black, white bold.
Greyscale headings and text; links are the only colour.
Terminal greens on green-black, lime inline code, cyan links.
Gold and brown headings on beige paper (light) or warm charcoal (dark), ink-blue links.
Clean blue headings on the theme background, plain bold, blue inline code.
Orange headings, warm greys, blue links; black (dark) or beige paper (light).
Document style: near-white or near-black headings, warm grey text, red inline code, blue links.
Built-in VS Code preview look (turns all colouring off).
markdownPreviewPalettes.preset.markdownDescription: Colour preset for the Markdown preview. `default` restores the built-in VS Code look. High-contrast themes always keep the built-in look.
